visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: document icon per link, no images
visualCharacteristics.structure: group title + divider rule + vertical list of document links (truncated with ellipsis)
visualCharacteristics.columns: 4 on wide desktop, 3 on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile

contentPattern: Document link lists (source linkList). One row per group: cell 1 group title (year '2026' or topic), cell 2 bulleted list (or paragraphs) of links to PDF reports ('Annual Report', 'Modern Slavery Statement'). Section headings and the 'Archive and accessible reports' button are default content.
